curriculum.subject: English Language Activities
curriculum.outcomeText: identify the letters Aa, Mm, Tt and Ee in given words

mission.title: Letter Detectives: A, M, T and E

interactions.prompt: Which is the capital letter A?
interactions.retryHint: Look for two slanting lines with a line across.
Say /m/ and listen to the first sound.

interactions.prompt: Find the word that contains Tt.
interactions.retryHint: Scan every letter in each short word.
Look at the last letter of each word.

interactions.prompt: Which word has both Aa and Tt?
interactions.feedback: Sharp eyes! Mat contains both a and t.
interactions.retryHint: Check for two target letters inside one word.

interactions.prompt: Which letter trail completes m_t → mat and m_t → met?
interactions.feedback: Case closed! You used A and E to build both words.
interactions.retryHint: Read each completed word: mat first, then met.
